## About this page

Items you deleted wait here before they are gone for good. Open one to restore it, or empty the trash to delete everything in it now.

#### How it works

An item in the trash is left out of lists, search, autofill and the Health page, and out of every export except the WM Pass vault. It keeps its history and attachments until it is deleted for good.

Open an item here and choose **Restore** to put it back as it was, or **Delete for good** to remove it now. In the [Trash screen](/guide/screens/#screen-trash), Ctrl-click, or Cmd-click on a Mac, chooses several items to restore or delete for good at once.

Items that have been here longer than [Keep deleted items for](/guide/settings/trash/#action-trash-keep) are deleted for good on their own.

#### Limits

Deleting an item for good removes it from this vault, and from your other devices as they sync. A backup or copy of the vault made before then still holds it.

#### On Android

An item in the trash is left out of lists, search, autofill and the Health page, and out of every export except the WM Pass vault. It keeps its history and attachments until it is deleted for good.

Open an item here and choose **Restore** to put it back as it was, or **Delete for good** to remove it now.

How long items wait here is set by [Keep deleted items for](/guide/settings/trash/#action-trash-keep).

See also [Trash screen](/guide/screens/#screen-trash), [Keep deleted items for](/guide/settings/trash/#action-trash-keep), [Empty the trash](/guide/settings/trash/#action-empty-trash), [Backups](/guide/settings/backup/).

<a id="action-trash-keep"></a>

## Keep deleted items for

How long an item stays in the trash before it is deleted for good, with its attachments.

#### How it works

The choice is saved in the vault itself, not in this app's settings. It goes wherever the vault goes, and it is not part of a settings file.

Items past this age are deleted the next time the vault is opened.

The terminal app can also set it to keep items until the trash is emptied. That shows here as **Until emptied**.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| 7 days | For a vault you tidy often. A mistake has a week to be noticed. |
| 30 days | Enough time to notice most mistakes. |
| 90 days | Room for a mistake you find only when you next need the item. |
| 365 days | Deleted items stay for a year. |

#### On Android

The choice is saved in the vault itself, not in this app's settings. It goes wherever the vault goes, and it is not part of a settings file.

See also [Trash](/guide/settings/trash/), [Settings file](/guide/settings/file/).

<a id="action-empty-trash"></a>

## Empty the trash

Deletes every item in the trash for good, with their attachments, once you confirm.

#### Limits

There is no undo. Only a backup made before you emptied it still holds the items.

With sync, an item that another device put back from the trash before it heard of the emptying comes back, whole, on every device.

See also [Trash](/guide/settings/trash/), [Backups](/guide/settings/backup/).
